title: A local erase waits twice for a hung import pass: erased's drained() then deleteOwed's own drained(), each up to 2 s, so the Health delete can start after about 4 s, past AC10's 2 s bound. Must be on main before build 11
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/Health/AppleHealthSync.swift:121 erased drains, then deleteOwed's claim drains again. Fix: one shared drain deadline. Test: a hung correction of a written id; the delete begins within 2 s. Codex, PR 1218 final check
